preconditions.description: The length of the binary representation of r is between 1 and 10^6.
The lengths of the binary representations of l and r are both equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in l)
preconditions.description: The binary representation of l consists only of digits 0 and 1.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in r)
preconditions.description: The binary representation of r consists only of digits 0 and 1.
The decimal value of l is less than or equal to the decimal value of r.

postconditions.description: The output is the binary representation of the maximum XOR value f(l, r) without leading zeros.
